products.name: Pinecone
products.note: Vector database; RAG infrastructure; data residency options; enterprise security

profile_text.body:
Pinecone is a company that develops and operates a fully managed vector database designed for AI applications. According to its own site, the platform can search through billions of items for similar matches to any object in milliseconds, with writes that are instantly searchable, automatic indexing, and query performance that the company describes as staying fast at any scale.

Pinecone's primary product is its vector database, which the site positions as infrastructure for retrieval-augmented generation and next-generation search, accessible via API. The tracked product record notes additional capabilities including RAG infrastructure, data residency options, and enterprise security features.

No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data for Pinecone.
